default.question: What actually happens during the 2 days?
default.answer:
Day 1 is frameworks and strategy. We cover customer acquisition from first principles — how to identify your ideal buyer, build messaging that converts, and architect a paid and organic system that scales.

Day 2 is execution. You'll build your actual 90-day plan in the room with coaching from the team. You leave with something you can deploy on Monday morning.

default.question: What do I walk away with?
default.answer:
Three things:

  • A documented 90-day marketing plan — written and reviewed in the room, specific to your business
  • The complete playbook — every framework, template, and swipe file from both days
  • Access to the alumni network — a private community of operators who've been through the program

default.question: Is this right for my business size or industry?
default.answer:
Yes, if you're generating revenue and want to grow it. This isn't a beginner course — we assume you have a product people want and you're trying to pour fuel on the fire.

We've worked with companies across dozens of industries. The principles are universal.

default.question: How much are tickets?
default.answer:
Tickets are $X,XXX per person. Group pricing is available for teams of 3 or more. Payment plans are available — reach out before buying.

Compare that to a single month of wasted ad spend or one bad hire. This pays for itself the first time you implement one framework.
